planPhases.title: Fix sort parameter parsing in queryParser.ts to accept hyphenated format
planPhases.notes: Added HYPHENATED_SORT_MAP to convert price-asc, price-desc, rating-desc, name-asc, name-desc to camelCase equivalents. All sort-related tests pass.

planPhases.title: Fix response envelope field names in productService.ts (count→total, pages→totalPages)
planPhases.notes: Renamed count→total and pages→totalPages in productService.ts return value. Also fixed pre-existing build errors: removed unused Product import, and corrected InternalSort type incompatibility with SortOption by using Omit<ProductQuery, 'sort'> & { sort?: InternalSort } in both queryParser.ts and productService.ts. All 18 tests pass, build succeeds.
